settingGroups.admin_feedback.name: Feedback
settingLabels.admin_feedback.module_enab: Shows the "Send feedback" link in the admin and lets administrators send feedback to the makers of Endora Commerce. Switch it off if this instance must not send any data to Endora: the link disappears and nothing is sent. Nothing is stored either way.
settingLabels.admin_feedback.relay_url.d: The http(s) address feedback is sent to. Leave the default to reach Endora support. Empty switches sending off while keeping the module on.
actions.openAdminFeedbackSettings.label: Feedback settings
actions.openAdminFeedbackSettings.descri: Decide whether administrators can send feedback to Endora, and where it goes
errors.ADMIN_FEEDBACK_NOT_CONFIGURED: Sending feedback is switched off on this instance.
errors.ADMIN_FEEDBACK_DELIVERY_FAILED: Your feedback could not be delivered. Try again later.
